entries.content: Chad Dickson, formerly Numbuh 274, was one the previous Soopreme Leaduh of the Kids Next Door(succeeding Numbuh 100 and preceding Numbuh 362) and Numbuh 1's mentor, admired as "the best there is"—until he defected to the Teen Ninjas upon turning thirteen. Once revered, he is now despised within the KND for turning traitor. Arrogant and self-assured, he still claims to be "the best there is." He has short blond hair and is the son of Mighty Mom and Destructo Dad, much to his embarrassment.

Cree Lincoln, formerly Numbuh 11, is Numbuh 5’s sixteen-year-old sister and a high-ranking Teen Ninja. Once the skilled and charismatic leader of Sector V, she evaded decommissioning upon turning thirteen, defecting with her memories intact. Her betrayal severely strained her bond with Numbuh 5, though traces of sisterly care remain beneath their rivalry. Numbuh 2 harbors an obvious crush on her, much to her irritation. She believes Maurice (formerly Numbuh 9) is her boyfriend—but he has secrets of his own. When not on Teen Ninja business, she typically wears a pink midriff-baring T-shirt, oversized blue jeans, and brown loafers. She has natural black hair styled in dreadlocks and dark brown eyes.

Mr. Boss, the cigar-chomping CEO of a multinational company, serves as the KND villains’ second-in-command after Father, frequently leading joint operations. He harbors an intense loathing for children—except his own—and once attempted to send his employees’ daughters to Pluto. Despite his villainous pursuits, he maintains a strong bond with his kids: Numbuh 86, Numbuh 85, and Shaunie Fulbright. Towering and broad-shouldered, he sports a bald head, a thick mustache, a hunched posture, and a perpetually oversized cigar clamped between his teeth. His usual attire consists of a blue suit, a gray-striped tie, and brown shoes. Among his many frustrations, none vex him more than the Toiletnator’s incompetence; his exasperated reaction to the bumbling villain’s presence is always the same: "Aw, geez! It’s the Toiletnator!"

Grandfather, the father of Monty Uno (Numbuh 0) and Father, and Numbuh 1’s paternal grandfather, once ruled the world as a tyrant, forcing children to produce tapioca pudding for him n brutal factories. With the ability to age victims into "Senior Citizombies" at a touch and near-indestructible durability, he remains the KND’s most formidable foe, making even Father look like a saint by comparison. Though Monty defeated him, Grandfather still favors him over his other son, Benedict, whom he sees as a failure. Now decommissioned and senile, he has forgotten his past and the immense power he once wielded.

The Galactic Kids Next Door is a clandestine faction of extraterrestrial children waging an all-out war on adulthood, which they consider a disease that must be eradicated. Unlike the Earth-based KND, which targets only oppressive adults, they seek to eliminate anyone over thirteen by any means necessary. Entry into their ranks is highly selective, with only one operative chosen per planet through an undisclosed process. As the highest branch of the KND, their existence remains a closely guarded secret, even from Earth's Soopreme Leaduh. Unbeknownst to the Earth-based KND, they have set their sights on recruiting Numbuh 1, intent on severing his ties to his family and friends and ensuring his unwavering allegiance to their cause. Numbuh 74.239 and Lizzie Devine(aka Numbuh Vine) are members.

Laura Limpin is a kindhearted young girl with an explosive secret: when angered, she transforms into the Big Badolescent, a monstrous, super-strong brute. Despite her gentle nature, even the smallest frustration can trigger her transformation. She has an intense dislike for coconuts and anything coconut-flavored. In her normal form, Laura typically wears red round glasses, brown pigtails, a red overall dress with a yellow heart on the front, and white Mary Janes. As the Big Badolescent, she dons a red bodysuit with a bold yellow "A" on the chest, yellow gloves, a red mask, and white boots. Interestingly, her transformation negates her need for glasses.
The evil employees of the Tasty Taste Ice Cream Corporation, the Ice Cream Men usually serve as henchmen for the Delightful Children, Father, and occasionally Mr. Boss.

Count Spankulot is a vampire-themed vigilante who punishes misbehaving children with spankings. He terrorizes his victims by dramatically announcing their crimes and his name before delivering punishment. He speaks with a deep Romanian accent and can transform others into spanking-obsessed vampires by touching them with his bare hands. He wears a slate-gray suit with matching pants, black dress shoes, a cape resembling bat wings, a medallion with an "S," and always keeps his hands covered with white gloves.

The Toiletnator (real name Lou Pottingsworth III) is a laughably inept toilet-themed villain. Dismissed as a non-threat by the KND and an embarrassment by other villains—especially Mr. Boss—his powers to control toilets and fire toilet paper are rarely useful. Ironically, he's Numbuh 4’s long-lost uncle(due to being Mr. Beetles' lost-lost twin brother), yet harbors a particular hatred for him above all KND operatives. His outfit consists of a yellow plumber's suit, rubberized boots, toilet paper roll gauntlets, a cape fastened by a toilet seat, and a cowl resembling a toilet paper roll with cyan visors.

Gramma Stuffum, a villainous old German woman, obsessively force-feeds children her vile cooking to fatten them up, believing immobility keeps them out of trouble. She has the power to animate her cooking into living minions that forcibly feed themselves to kids, led by her three constant companions: Liver and the two Onions.

Knightbrace (real name Mr. Jelly) is a dental-obsessed villain whose passion for oral hygiene borders on madness. Expelled from dental school for attempting to put braces on babies, he was forced to work at his family's candy shop. Watching children ruin their teeth with sugar pushed him over the edge, turning him into a deranged vigilante determined to enforce perfect dental care—by any means necessary. Dressed in a dark blue-purple costume emblazoned with a tooth symbol, he wears a large, halo-shaped retainer that gives him a pronounced lisp. His arsenal includes an oversized toothbrush, which he wields as both a bludgeon and a pole vault, a mouth mirror for inspections, and gloves capable of spraying powerful jets of toothpaste.

Stickybeard, a candy-obsessed pirate, sails the suburbs aboard his ship, the Sweet Revenge, raiding kids and rivals for sweets with his crew. Hoarding candy like treasure, he even builds his ship and weapons—like candy cane swords and gumball cannons—out of it. Though he despises the KND, he respects Numbuh 5 as a fellow sweet tooth and hopes to recruit her as his successor, despite her allegiance to the KND. A towering man with a peg leg and hook hand made of peppermint, his teeth are heavily decayed from years of constant sugar consumption. He earns his namesake from his bushy orange beard, which has an assortment of small pieces of candy stuck in it. Like most kids, he loathes vegetables, and he's not above forming allegiances with the KND if a vegetable-related threat has been let loose.

Professor XXXL is a deranged scientist obsessed with crafting the perfect snow cone. Though his intentions are harmless, the Kids Next Door always assume he's scheming something evil. His dramatic, villainous behavior and poor justifications only reinforce their suspicions. Towering and rotund, he frequently afflicts himself with mutations which give him various animal parts.

Chester, a rotund and ruthlessly greedy adult villain, exploits children for profit under the guise of a self-proclaimed genius scientist. His inventions serve no purpose beyond tormenting kids, fueling schemes as absurd as they are sinister. Among his most infamous plots are a fast-food chain that turned children into shark burgers, a device that transformed kids into moose to harvest their antlers for popsicle sticks, and a summer camp designed to brainwash campers into manufacturing wallets for his personal gain. A large man with a round nose and a thick brown mustache, Chester frequently alters his appearance with various disguises to further his schemes.

The Common Cold is an eternally ill villain with pale skin who wishes to spread his cold to everyone else in the world. Armed with a nose-shaped launcher that shoots mucus at foes, he navigates the skies with a jetpack, though a dose of orange juice can easily thwart him. Anna Worthington is his niece.

The Crazy Old Cat Lady, an elderly woman devoted to her thousands of black-and-white cats, calls them "her babies" and shares an unbreakable bond with them. This connection grants her the power to command them, even ordering attacks when threatened. In dire situations, her cats can merge into a massive feline form around her, which she directly controls.

Angelo Fizz(known by most as Mr. Fizz) is the Spanish head of the Soda Control Board, who has raised the legal soda drinking age to thirteen, causing numerous underground soda bars to appear as a result. He enforces this law strongly, inevitably putting him in conflict with the Kids Next Door, particularly Numbuh 2. He himself loves soda and can't get enough of it. His default outfit is a fancy white suit and purple glasses. He uses various weapons based on soda bottles and barrels, but he can't stand the sound of children.

The Splinter Cell is believed to be a rogue faction within the Kids Next Door, dedicated to eradicating all adults—good or bad. This directly opposes the KND’s core ideology, which targets only tyrannical adults and teens. Though select KND operatives, including Sector V and Numbuh 362, are aware of their existence, they remain unaware of the truth: the Splinter Cell is actually a front for the secretive Galactic KND, using the guise of a rogue group to divert attention from their true operations on Earth.

Lizzie Devine, Numbuh 1’s shrill and demanding girlfriend, is notoriously clingy, leading Sector V to avoid her. She, in turn, dismisses them and the KND as a waste of time. Despite this, she genuinely cares for her boyfriend, affectionately calling him "Nigey," though his unwavering dedication to the KND frequently strains their relationship. Unbeknownst to all—Numbuh 1 included—Lizzie is actually a Galactic KND operative known as "Numbuh Vine." Her presence on Earth, as well as the true purpose behind her relationship with Numbuh 1, remains a mystery. In her human guise, she has auburn hair typically styled in braids with sky-blue bobbles, round glasses worn at all times, a bright yellow T-shirt with a sky-blue circle on the front, a blue skirt, and white sneakers. However, her true form resembles an inverted potted plant, with a squid-like appearance, white beady eyes, and five vine-like appendages that function as limbs.

Heinrich Von Marzipan, once Numbuh 5's friend and candy-hunting partner, is now her rival. An overweight German boy obsessed with sweets, he relentlessly pursues forbidden candy worldwide, ignoring the consequences of doing so. Originally a beautiful girl named Henrietta, he was cursed in Guatemala years ago, losing both his gender and femininity, and has held a grudge against Numbuh 5 ever since. His character parodies Indiana Jones-style Nazi villains like René Belloq. Numbuh 5 affectionately calls him "Heinie." He is a very chubby boy with a blonde bowl cut.

Decades ago, Grandfather ruled the world with an iron fist until his firstborn son, Monty Uno, found the Book of KND, became Numbuh Zero, and founded the KND's 7th Age, leading a rebellion that decommissioned Grandfather, thus stripping him of his powers(and memories) and ending his tyranny. Now long-decommissioned himself, Numbuh Zero became a legend over time, his past fading into myth. In the present day, Monty is a clueless, sousaphone-loving dad who embarrasses Numbuh 1 at every turn—though his son still loves him. He is Father's older brother and Mrs. Uno's husband. Due to his decommissioned status, he is completely unaware of Father and Grandfather's evil.

Mrs. Uno, Numbuh 1's mother and Monty Uno's wife, is a cheerful woman who embarrasses her son as much as his father does. Once Numbuh 999, the KND's first female operative, she has long since been decommissioned.

Tommy Gilligan, Numbuh 2's seven-year-old brother, the younger son of Betty Gilligan and Hoagie Gilligan Sr.,, and the younger grandson of Grandma Lydia, is an excitable child eager to fight adult tyranny. He once trained as a cadet at the Arctic Base alongside Numbuh 83 and Numbuh 84, hoping to become a KND operative like his brother. However, a scheme by Father to transform the KND into animals ended up cutting his career short. Now, he fights solo as "The Tommy," a dramatic vigilante clad in a fedora and cape.

Mushi Sanban is Numbuh 3's five-year-old sister, and the younger daughter of Kani Sanban and Genki Sanban. She appears to be just as cute and cuddly as her sibling—perhaps even more so—but beneath her sweet exterior lurks a deeply obsessive, unstable, and psychotic mind. Her typical attire is similar to that of her sister's but with a light purple sweater.

Kani Sanban, the grumpy father of Numbuh 3 and Mushi Sanban and husband to Genki Sanban, has a short temper and a strong preference for cold temperatures, getting irritated whenever someone turns up the thermostat in his house. Despite his grouchiness and his penchant for being dramatic, he deeply loves his family.

Genki Sanban, a stern businesswoman and Betty Gilligan's boss, is the mother of Numbuh 3 and Mushi Sanban and the wife of Kani Sanban. Despite her strict demeanor, she deeply cares for her daughters and strives to give them a happier childhood than she had.

Betty Gilligan, mother of Numbuh 2 and Tommy Gilligan, widow of Hoagie Gilligan Sr., and daughter of Grandma Lydia, is a timid but friendly woman. Aware of Numbuh 2's use of 2x4 technology but not of his status as a KND operative, she also wields advanced gadgets of her own.

Hogarth "Hoagie" Gilligan Sr., late father of Numbuh 2 and Tommy Gilligan and husband to Betty Gilligan, was a passionate inventor known for adding needless modifications to everyday items. His inventiveness was passed on to both of his sons.

Joey Beetles, Numbuh 4's baby brother, is an undiscovered dodgeball prodigy fated to become the best dodgeball player in the world, despite being too young to talk. Though Numbuh 4 sometimes finds him annoying, his deep love and protectiveness for Joey are undeniable. Sydney Beetles and Mrs. Beetles are his parents.

Sydney Beetles, father of Numbuh 4 and Joey, is a cheerful, oblivious office worker under Mr. Boss. Despite witnessing his son's dangerous activities firsthand, he remains unaware of the KND. He loves his family and enjoys attending fatherhood seminars. Unbeknownst to him, the Toiletnator is his long-lost twin brother.

Mrs. Beetles is the mother of Numbuh 4 and Joey and the wife of Mr. Beetles. She shares the cheerful, oblivious disposition of her husband, but will become furious if her priceless vases are destroyed.

Dr. Lincoln is the father of Cree and Numbuh 5. An African-American doctor whose personality and speech mannerisms are similar to those of Bill Cosby, he's an easy-going man who's oblivious to the KND's activities, like most adults. He often embarrasses his daughters by sharing personal details about them in front of their friends. He is unaware of their rivalry and remains clueless about their ongoing fights.

Mrs. Lincoln is the cheerful Afro-French mother of Cree and Numbuh 5, and the wife of Dr. Lincoln. Like her husband, she's oblivious to KND activities and has no idea that her daughters do not get along. She speaks with a French accent.

Maurice, formerly Numbuh 9, was once a beloved KND operative and Sector V member alongside Cree Lincoln and Numbuh 5. Officially, he was decommissioned at thirteen, but he was actually secretly allowed to retain his memories and join the Teens Next Door as a spy, aiding the KND undercover. Only a few know the truth, including Numbuh 5—both she and Cree have crushes on him, though Cree remains unaware that his relationship with her is merely a cover for his infiltration of the Teen Ninjas.

"Leaky" Leona, a student at Sector V's elementary school, discovered the Fountain of Youth in an underground school beneath the girls' bathroom 300 years ago. She has since kept its existence a secret, relying on it to maintain her youth. Having never removed her braces, she speaks with a stutter and spits when she talks. Without regular drinks from the fountain, she would rapidly age and die.

Mrs. Thompson is an attractive elementary school teacher who is Numbuh 4 and Numbuh 5's homeroom teacher at Gallagher Elementary School. She is secretly the leader of the Weredogs, due to having been inflicted with a curse by her bitter ex-husband.
Weredogs are werewolf-like monsters whose diets consist of children's homework. However, poorly-written or unfinished homework is poisonous to them.

The Teen Ninjas, led by The Steve, are a faction of teenagers armed with B.R.A.s (Battle Ready Armor). They collaborate with villains like Father and the Delightful Children From Down the Lane. Notable members include former KND operatives Cree Lincoln and Chad Dickson, who often lead them in battle. Many other ex-operatives who evaded decommissioning at thirteen also serve in their ranks.

The Steve is the teenage leader of the Teen Ninjas. While he appears to be a brainless showboat who has no idea what's going on around him, it's all an act - he knows exactly what he's doing and can in fact be rather devious and resourceful, as is befitting of a leader. His typical attire includes olive-green jeans with a dark jacket tied around his waist, alongside a red t-shirt with rolled-up sleeves, sneakers, and black sunglasses. He has thick, stylized brown hair.

Mrs. Dickson is Chad Dickson's embarrassing mother and one half of the "Mega Mom and Destructo Dad" duo, alongside her husband. When conducting villany, she wears a mask that is a giant replica of her own head, and she can unleash "stupefying" rays that completely immobilize targets.

Destructo Dad is Chad Dickson's embarrassing father and the other half of the "Mega Mom and Destructo Dad" duo, alongside his wife. When conducting villainy, he wears a mask that is a giant replica of his own head, and can also unleash "stupefying" rays that completely immobilize targets.

The Six-Gum Gang are a group of prepubescent cowboy-style robbers who work for the Delightful Children From Down The Lane. Their names are Runt, Lunk, Goof, Wilbur, and Dixie. Runt is the leader, despite being the smallest and seemingly the youngest, while Dixie is the sole female in the group. They have guns that shoot immobilizing wads of chewing gum.

King Sandy is a delusional young boy who resides in an oversized sandcastle and thinks he is a king. He has an unrequited crush on Numbuh 3, who he considers his "princess", despite her being older than him. He is served by the "Knights of the Round Towel", who are actually his dim-witted, muscular older cousins. If he is told that he is only pretending, he will typically fly into a petulant rage.

Sector A is an Amish KND sector in the rural northeastern United States. Avoiding 2x4 technology and violence due to their peaceful surroundings, they are the only operatives who use real names instead of numbers. The team consists of Numbuh Jebediah (leader), Numbuh Ezekiel (operative), and Numbuh Rebecca (2x4 technology officer—if they had any).

Sector C is a KND sector located in China. It holds the largest number of operatives belonging to a single sector, with several 2x4 technology officers and two different sector leaders. The base is built in a gigantic bonsai tree.
Sector E is a KND sector located in London, England.
Sector F is a KND sector located in France. Their uniforms include baguettes on their arms and red beret helmets, both being stereotypes to France.
Sector H is a KND sector located in Hawaii.

Sector HH, also known as the KND Haircut Headquarters, is where some of the KND's greatest hair surgeons work to save the hairdos of KND operatives everywhere. Thousands of kids end up here every year because their parents cut their hair appallingly and turn them into grotesque freak shows. They also conduct hair-related experiments.
Sector I is a KND sector located in India.

Sector J, led by Numbuh 1-Love, is a KND sector in Jamaica. Led by Numbuh 1-Love, It hosts an annual retreat for sector leaders and top operatives at its lavish treehouse, which boasts 52 swimming pools, a 24-hour ice cream buffet, and 365 miles of water slides. Notably, none of its operatives wear underwear.

Sector L, an American KND sector led by Numbuh 10, operates the KND News Network. Key members include Numbuh 10 (white female, leader, lead anchor), Numbuh 31 (African-American male, anchorman with terrible jokes), and Numbuh 8x10 (white male, photographer).

Sector N, based in Tennessee, consists of four operatives: Numbuh 13, Numbuh 14 (a white female—the Sector's leader who's responsible for managing his mishaps), Numbuh 15 (a white male), and Numbuh 16 (a male of Egyptian heritage). Numbuh 13 is so universally disliked by his team that they frequently attempt to get rid of him—sometimes by fabricating emergencies to villains or other operatives.
Sector P is a KND sector located in Pompeii, Italy. Its operatives have a lot of experience with volcanoes and lava.
Sector T is a KND sector located in the US state of Texas.
Sector U is a KND sector located in Guatemala.

Sector X, a KND sector based in a Louisiana swamp, operates from a rundown treehouse. Hot-air balloons on the roof provide emergency escape routes. The team consists of three members: Numbuh 78 (leader, African-American girl), Numbuh 34 (white boy, combat expert, considered the toughest operative in his sector), and Numbuh 42 (white, overweight, nerdy boy, friends with Numbuh 2, more focused on trading cards than missions).

The KND Arctic Base, second only to the Moonbase in importance, lies deep within the coldest reaches of the Arctic. Spanning 42 subterranean levels, it functions as both a rigorous training ground for Cadets Next Door and a high-security prison for captured KND villains

The KND Moonbase is the organization's top-secret global headquarters, home to the Soopreme Leaduh, high-ranking operatives, and a prison for fugitive ex-operatives awaiting decommissioning. Located on the Moon, it oversees all KND operations.

The Deep Sea Science Lab is the KND's underwater base for scientific research, where the KND's greatest scientists and 2x4 technology specialists develop new advancements and innovations for the organization.
The B.A.J.O.O.K.A. (Blasts Aloft Juicy Overfilled Orange Kartons Amazingly) is a KND standard-issue 2x4 weapon. It is a mailbox that fires explosive orange juice cartons.
The B.A.T.T.E.R.B.E.A.T.E.R. (Beefy Artillery That Totally Easily Repels Bad Eggs And Thumps Enemy Rivals) is a KND standard-issue 2x4 weapon made of two egg beaters with a light bulb on top.

The B.O.N.G.O.S.K.O.P.E. (Binocularized Optical Night Glasses Or Sooper Kool Outasight Percussion Emoter) is a KND standard-issue 2x4 gadget. It is a set of binoculars made from bongo drums, tin cans, and baseball bat grips. It features night vision and a self-timed drum mode.
The B.O.T.T.L.E.C.A.P. (Big Old Totally Tremendous Launcher Emits Cola And Pop) is a KND standard-issue 2x4 weapon. It is a gun that fires soda.

The C.O.D.E.-M.O.D.U.L.E (Carrying Operatives' Data Entered Mainly On Digitally Uncrackable Little Electronics) is a one-of-a-kind 2x4 gadget and the Kids Next Door’s most vital device. Built from a modified waffle iron, it stores the genetic material of every operative. During initiation, recruits submit a booger, which the module analyzes before uploading their DNA to the Super Big Computermabob for identification. Housed in the Moonbase, it serves as the core of the KND’s security. Once an operative’s DNA is removed—typically after decommissioning—it cannot be re-entered, ensuring that former operatives can never formally rejoin. This failsafe prevents decommissioned agents from infiltrating or compromising KND systems.
The C.O.N.E.C.A.N.N.O.N. (Chucks Out Nearly Endless Cones And Nicely Nocks Out Nonkids) is a KND-standard 2x4 weapon. It is a metal pistol that fires ice cream cones.
The E.S.C.A.P.E.R. (Explosive Spraycans Carry Away People Escaping Rapidly) is a KND standard issue 2x4 vehicle. It is a flying vehicle equipped with guns that is known for its great speed.
The F.I.N.D.I.T. (Finding Instrument Naturally Detects Important Things) is a KND standard issue 2x4 gadget. It is a small radar made out of a light switch that is used to locate things.
The F.R.A.P.P.E. (Freeze Ray Always Paralyses Potential Enemies) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a freeze ray that is made up of a blender, a thermos, and a handle.

The G.O.G.E.T.T.E.R. (Giant Oversized Gunship Easily Transports Ten Escaped Runaways) is a KND standard issue 2x4 vehicle. It is a prison transport vehicle that is mainly used by the Decommissioning Squad to transport teenage operatives to the Moonbase for decommissioning, as well as to take captured villains to the Arctic Base for incarceration.
The G.U.M.Z.O.O.K.A. (Gumball Utilizing Mechanism Zings Overabundance Of Kandy Around) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a gumball-launching submachine gun made from a gum dispenser.

The L.U.N.C.H.B.O.C.K.S. (Largely Undercover Nuclear Computer Handles Balogna Or Complicated Komputer Stuff) is a KND standard issue 2x4 gadget. It is a computer hidden in a lunchbox that can search the entire KND Global Mainframe and has the "Supercool Nameinator Program", which generates acronyms on the fly for any given word.
The M.U.S.K.E.T. (Mustard Using Sidearm Kicks Enemy Tail) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a mustard-shooting gun made out of a mustard bottle.

The P.I.C.K.L.E.R. (Propels Innumerable Cucumbers Kapably Leveling Enemy Ranks) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a pickle-shooting gun used by Kids Next Door guards. It uses a can of shaving cream to create the force to propel the pickle at the target, with the pickles stored in a jar under the barrel.

The P.I.P.E.R. (Phone In Pipe Emergency Radio) is a KND standard issue 2x4 gadget. It is a portable phone constructed from pipes with antennae, and is a common method of communication between operatives.
The P.U.T.T.P.U.T.T. (Pistol Uses Tube To Project Unstoppable Tiny Torpedoes) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a gun made up of a minigolf plate, two handles, and a cardboard tube.
The S.C.A.M.P.E.R. (Shabby Camper Actually Makes Perfect Emergency Rescue-mabob) is a KND standard issue 2x4 vehicle. It is a redesigned flying camper that requires 5 people to be operated.
The S.C.A.M.P.P. (Soup Can And Magnified Photon Phlaser) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a laser weapon that uses a lens to convert a flashlight into a green energy ray.

The S.L.U.G.G.U.H. (Spring Loaded Upper-cutting Glove Gives Unbelievable Headache) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a mid-range melee weapon that consists of a boxing glove in a metal lamp shade, attached to springs and wooden planks.
The S.P.I.C.E.R. (Stingy Pepper Infused Cannon Enflames Retinas) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a heat ray powered by a chilli pepper.

The S.P.L.A.N.K.E.R. (Solid Pine Loaded Artillery Nicely Kicks Enemy Rear) is a KND standard issue 2x4 melee weapon. It is a melee weapon made out of two wood planks held together by a horseshoe magnet, with a fine-tooth saw bent over the hinge; it comes with a trigger that, when activated, temporarily deactivates the magnet and sends one of the planks forward at high speed, inflicting damage on its target. The saw's bendiness then sets the plank back again, making it ready for future use.

The S.Q.O.O.S.H.E.R. (Shooting Quarts Of Oozing Stuff Heavily Ensnaring Rivals) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a projectile that shoots glue. It consists of a tube of glue, pinned by two wooden planks.
The T.A.N.G.L.E.R. (Tosses Armored Nets Guaranteeing Lotsa Entangled Rivals) is a KND standard issue 2x4 weapon. It is a green launcher that can be loaded with nets or explosives.

The D.O.H.D.O.H. (Decommissioned Operative Hunter Drives On Hydrolics) is a KND 2x4 vehicle used by the Decommissioning Squad to capture operatives scheduled for decommissioning, particularly those who try to escape. It features a backwards buggy car with a jet engine, a hose-like neck, and a rowboat-shaped head armed with laser guns. Its dodo-like appearance inspired its name.

Shaun "Shaunie" Fulbright is the youngest brother of Numbuh 86 and Numbuh 85, and the youngest son of Mr. Boss. Unlike his two older siblings, he is not a KND operative, but he's just as terrified of Numbuh 86's temper as Numbuh 85 is.

Sector Z was once a team of elite Kids Next Door operatives before falling victim to Father's Delightfulization Chamber. What was meant to be a temporary process became irreversible due to a freak accident, destroying the Chamber and permanently warping their minds beyond measure. Now known as the Delightful Children From Down The Lane, they have been brainwashed into perfect obedience, their individuality erased. Within the KND, they are presumed missing. The five former operatives were: Numbuh 0.1 (Bruce), Numbuh 0.2 (David), Numbuh 0.3 (Alessandra), Numbuh 0.4 (Lenny), and Numbuh 0.5 (Constance).

Decommissioning is the Kids Next Door's process for erasing operatives' memories once they turn thirteen. Overseen by Numbuh 86 and her Decommissioning Squad, it ensures no teenager retains knowledge of the KND's secrets—unless they escape, are accepted as teen spies, or(in rare cases) are recommissioned via a Recommissioning Module. Near their thirteenth birthday, an operative is flagged for removal. Some accept their fate with a farewell bash; others resist, forcing the squad to hunt them down and drag them to the Moonbase. There, they’re strapped into the Decommissioning Chamber, where plungers literally wipe their memories clean. Their DNA is then permanently removed from the C.O.D.E.-M.O.D.U.L.E., severing all ties to the organization. While KND-related memories vanish(including their memories of its villains), essential ones—like family and school—remain. Once released, they live as normal teenagers. Their names are listed on the KND Nightly News on the night of their decommissioning(accompanied by a moment of silence) to notify all operatives, who are strictly forbidden from interfering with their post-KND lives. In rare cases, operatives guilty of severe misconduct face dishonorable decommissioning regardless of age.

The KND Global Command is the highest-ranking authority within the Kids Next Door, responsible for issuing mission orders, overseeing operations, and managing key assets such as the C.O.D.E.-M.O.D.U.L.E. and the Super Incredibly Big Computermabob. All directives pass through Global Command before reaching Numbuh 65.3, who relays the information to other Sectors and operatives. Additionally, all Teens Next Door operatives report directly to them. Composed of the most senior operatives, its known members include the Soopreme Leaduh (Numbuh 362), the Head of Decommissioning (Numbuh 86), Numbuh 60, Numbuh 65.3, Numbuh 35, and other high-ranking officers and diplomats, including Numbuh Infinity. While the Global Command governs the KND on Earth, the secretive Galactic Kids Next Door outrank them—though no one on Earth knows of their existence.

Numbuh 23(real name Virginia Sims) is the cheerful and happy-go-lucky Incendiary Confectionery Munitions Agent of Sector K, specializing in the design and development of candy-based 2x4 technology. She typically wears a black blouse, grey pants, black strapped Mary Janes with red triangle markings, yellow earrings, and two yellow bracelets on each wrist. Her brown hair is styled in pigtails with red hair holders, and she often carries a red backpack.

A chubby African-American member of Sector L, Numbuh 31 serves as the co-anchor of the KND Nightly News. His humor rivals Numbuh 2’s but is even worse, frequently frustrating his leader and fellow anchor, Numbuh 10, with his terrible jokes—especially on-air.

A member of Sector X, Numbuh 34 serves as the team’s hand-to-hand combat officer. He is regarded as the toughest operative in his sector, relying on raw strength and brawling skills. He is a tall, husky boy with messy brown hair.

Numbuh 35(real name Bartie Stork) is a Kids Next Door operative and Global Command member stationed at the Moonbase. He informs operatives of summons to the Moonbase and, alongside Numbuh 86, holds the password to the KND Maximum Security Vault. His outfit includes a blue long-sleeved shirt, brown pants, black shoes, yellow gloves, and a colander-adapted samurai-style helmet with "35" on it. He has light-brown hair.

Sector X's 2x4 Technology Officer, Numbuh 42 is a nerdy, cowardly operative with a strong interest in Yipper trading cards and sci-fi films, often prioritizing them over his team duties. He shares a friendship with Numbuh 2, providing him with Yipper cards. Because Sector X gets relatively few missions, he enjoys ample free time to expand his card collection. Numbuh 42 is short, chubby, with spiky brown hair, typically wearing a yellow shirt, orange gloves, a red neckerchief, brown pants, and two white coffee mugs strapped to his head.

Numbuh 44A(real name Pete Doblemitz), is a KND operative who shares his number and position with his twin brother, Numbuh 44B. Together, they serve as infantry guards primarily stationed at the Moonbase. Numbuh 44A wears a green uniform and a samurai-style helmet (adapted from a colander) marked with "44A."

Numbuh 44B(real name Peter Doblemitz), is a KND operative who shares his number and position with his twin brother, Numbuh 44A. Together, they serve as infantry guards primarily stationed at the Moonbase. Numbuh 44B wears a green uniform and a samurai-style helmet (adapted from a colander) marked with "44B."

A KND scientist, Numbuh 71.562 has short black hair, buck teeth, and wears thick-rimmed glasses. His attire includes a baggy lab coat, dark blue pants, a light blue shirt, a red bow tie, and black shoes. He works at the Deep Sea Science Lab and the Moonbase while attending Honors Pre-Science class as a fifth grader. His radical ideas often lead to conflicts with fellow scientist Numbuh 74.239, whom he believes to be a fourth grader. Unbeknownst to most, he is affiliated with the Splinter Cell.

Numbuh 78(real name Angelie) is the leader of Sector X, overseeing teammates Numbuh 34 and Numbuh 42 while delivering commands on missions. An African-American girl, her typical attire is a purple dress with short sleeves, purple gloves, dark purple boots, a purple visor, and a cooking pot helmet (with holes for her braided hair) marked with "78" in yellow paint.

A former Soopreme Leaduh of the Kids Next Door, Numbuh 100 led the organization prior to Numbuh 274 and Numbuh 362. He was Soopreme Leaduh when the current Sector V members were inducted into the KND. Renowned for his natural leadership skills, he earned widespread respect as one of the few who could handle the role's demands. Numbuh 100 spoke with a southwestern American accent and had brown hair that obscured the top half of his face. Now decommissioned after aging out of the KND, his current whereabouts are unknown to all but the Global Command.

Numbuh 101 serves as the head curator of the Kids Next Door Seriously Cool Museum of Artifacts and Stuff, which houses significant items from KND history, including the KNDNA Tracker and Recommissioning Module. He is one of the few operatives who believes in the existence of Numbuh 0. He is a short, nerdy kid with a ginger bowl cut, thick glasses, and a giant purple blazer that he typically wears on top of a navy-blue shirt and brown shorts.

Numbuh 202 is the 2x4 Technology Officer of Sector G. She has blonde hair and wears a blue repairman's outfit, black shoes, and a blue cap. Frequently seen carrying a wrench, she’s easily recognizable by the prominent grease stain on the side of her face.

Once a school nurse at Gallagher Elementary, Nurse Claiborne turned villain after being exposed by Numbuh 2 for secretly spreading pinkeye with bacteria-filled water balloons to harvest crust for bake sale treats. After faking her demise, she resurfaced running the Rainbow Monkey Retirement Home—a front for converting Rainbow Monkey dolls into Rainbow Munchies cereal—only to be thwarted by Numbuh 3 and Numbuh 5. Beneath her nurturing act, Claiborne is cruel and greedy, viewing patients as profit sources. She has a stocky build, a cleft chin, pink lipstick, a bun with a green hairband, and wears a white medical coat, nurse’s cap, green cape, brown loafers, and latex gloves. A self-inflicted contaminated water balloon has left the left side of her face permanently scarred with pinkeye crust. Her arsenal includes a 2x4 tech water balloon launcher and a red handgun that fires giant band-aids.

Mr. Wink is one half of the villainous duo who battle the KND using robotic Super Chairs, alongside Mr. Fibb. He has a large brown tuft of hair covering his eyes with buffalo horns protruding from it. Often seated beside Mr. Fibb, he speaks in an alternating pattern with his partner, frequently asking rhetorical questions and addressing him by name at the end of each sentence.

Mr. Fibb, is one half of the villainous duo who battle the KND using robotic Super Chairs, alongside Mr. Wink. He has walrus tusks and very large, flipper-like webbed hands. Always seen seated next to Mr. Wink, he shares an alternating speech pattern with his partner, often posing rhetorical questions and addressing Mr. Wink by name at the end of each sentence.

James "Jimmy" Nixon McGarfield is the Fourth Grade Class President at Gallagher Elementary School. A heavyset boy with curly red hair and large round glasses, he wears a white pinstripe suit, a cowboy hat, black dress shoes, a pink dress shirt, and a bolo tie with a red rosette clasp. Mild-mannered and friendly, Jimmy is regarded as a fair and just politician with a refined Southern gentleman demeanor. Well-liked by classmates, he’s a skilled orator who exudes confidence when addressing crowds. However, his outward composure hides a timid nature—he prefers to resolve disputes peacefully but wilts at the first sign of violence. Ashamed of his cowardice, he secretly envies Numbuh 1’s bravery—and harbors an unspoken crush on his girlfriend, Lizzie, while remaining oblivious to the affections of his devoted secretary, Anna Worthington.

Anna Worthington is the secretary to Gallagher Elementary's Fourth Grade Class President, James "Jimmy" Nixon McGarfield. A slim girl with blonde hair tied in a ponytail, she wears rectangular glasses, a magenta neckerchief, a pink blouse, a brown belt, a magenta skirt, and penny loafers. She often tucks a pencil behind her ear and carries a clipboard. Utterly devoted to Jimmy due to her love for him, Anna works diligently as his assistant. Though she doesn’t commit villainous acts herself, she has a sneaky side, often scheming behind the scenes for her own benefit or others'. She also has a temper. The Common Cold is her uncle, and she occasionally calls on him for favors.

Cheese Shogun Roquefort rules the "Cheese Empire," composed of stereotypical Japanese warriors made out of cheese. He commands an army of Cheese Ninjas, views cheese as more valuable than gold, and takes great offense at the idea of it being eaten. Despite his seriousness about cheese, he has a fondness for good jokes. He and his henchmen reside in an East-Asian temple known as the Cheese Temple.

The Cheese Ninjas are the loyal henchmen of Cheese Shogun Roquefort, tasked with capturing prisoners to work in the cheese mines located within the mountain beneath the Cheese Temple. Like their master, they reside in the temple, serving him with unwavering dedication.

Cuppa Joe is a coffee-themed villain whose name is a pun on "cup of Joe." Always seen with an oversized coffee mug, he constantly drinks coffee, keeping himself in a perpetual caffeine rush. This grants him enhanced strength, agility, and superhuman speed, though it also leaves his eyes twitching and sometimes bloodshot. He wears a yellow suit and matching fedora.

The Dodgeball Wizard is an eccentric old sorcerer determined to prove that adults can play dodgeball as well as any kid—and that only an adult can be the greatest dodgeball player ever. For sixty-four years, he has travelled the world, defeating skilled children in dodgeball matches. Using magic, he can conjure dodgeballs of any size and telekinetically hurl them at opponents. He also possesses the ability to fly.

Robin Food is a parody of Robin Hood who works as a cafeteria worker at a retirement home with his Merry Men. However, due to his laziness, he avoids cooking for the elderly and instead steals food from elementary school students, claiming it as an act of compassion. His justification ignores the fact that youth-oriented meals often cause digestive issues for the seniors. He wears a green outfit and hat resembling the classic Robin Hood attire.

Also known as "Margie," Madam Margaret is a young girl who masquerades as the principal of an all-girls school, using a robotic suit to appear as an adult. Driven by an extreme hatred for boys(far surpassing even Numbuh 86’s) due to years of teasing from her brothers, she seeks to create a world where the male sex has been eradicated. To achieve this, she leads the sinister "Girl Squad," wielding advanced "girlifying" rifles capable of instantly transforming anything feminine—including turning boys into girls. Her alternate future self, from 75 years ahead, has already succeeded in this vision and has provided Margaret with the technology and knowledge necessary to bring about the same fate in the present.

keys: Interesting Twins From Beneath The Mountain
entries.content: The Interesting Twins From Beneath The Mountain are a pair of Japanese twins—a boy and a girl—who serve Father. Similar to the Delightful Children From Down The Lane, they speak in monotone, often finishing each other's sentences, though they are more independent and have distinct personalities. The sister is dominant, prideful, and easily angered, while the brother is calmer, timid, and acts as the voice of reason, though his sister rarely listens to him when enraged. Both share an overconfidence in their abilities, considering failure "an impossibility." Dressed in matching blue Japanese school uniforms with large black shoes, they have yin-yang-like birthmarks on their faces. The sister has pigtails, while the brother sports a bowl cut. They are acrobatic, highly flexible, and skilled at fitting into tight spaces. Masters of disguise and espionage, they utilize realistic mechanical suits to impersonate others flawlessly or improvise disguises using everyday objects.
entries.comment: Interesting Twins From Beneath The Mountain

entries.content: Grandma Lydia is the heavyset mother of Betty Gilligan and the maternal grandmother of Numbuh 2 and Tommy Gilligan. Living with her daughter and grandsons, she leads the Senior Citizen Squad. She frequently insults and hits her grandsons with her cane, showing a particular disdain for Hoagie, whom she often mistakes for Tommy(possibly due to dementia). She speaks with a Yiddish accent.

A tro of elderly villains led by Grandma Lydia, the Senior Citizen Squad uses an anti-aging cream to temporarily regain the youth and agility of teenagers. Besides Lydia, the squad includes two of her male friends. In their older forms, they can combine their devices to form a mech called "Senior Citizen." While they don’t particularly like the KND, they are more focused on personal affairs—such as eating tapioca—rather than actively working to destroy the organization.

A 2x4 gadget designed by Numbuh 101, the KNDNA Tracker can locate anyone who has ever been a KND operative using even the smallest trace of their DNA. It resembles a calculator and is housed in the Kids Next Door Seriously Cool Museum of Artifacts and Stuff.

The Recommissioning Module is a 2x4 device said to have been created by Numbuh 0, likely at the start of the 7th Age of the KND. By inserting DNA from an active KND operative, it can restore the KND-related memories of any former operative or even non-members who were decommissioned for any reason. It is currently housed in the Kids Next Door Seriously Cool Museum of Artifacts and Stuff.

The B.R.A. (Battle Ready Armor) is a mass produced high-tech suit used by Teen Ninjas, including Cree Lincoln and Chad Dickson. Though resembling an ordinary bra when inactive, it unfolds into metallic multi-purpose ninja armor, regularly worn by teenage villains—male and female alike. It features a built-in laser gun for combat, allows its users to fly, and can perfectly replicate another person’s appearance for disguises. Some teenage-operated bikes are also equipped with Battle Ready Armor.

A wildly popular plush toy franchise, Rainbow Monkeys come in various colors and themed variants. The brand spans TV series, theatrical movies, and even an ice show. Their signature song is as follows:

Rainbow Monkeys, Rainbow Monkeys,
Oh, so very round and super chunky,
Bringing love where ever they go,
Everyone's made of a big rainbow.
Oh, red and orange, and pink and blue,
Rainbow Monkeys, Rainbow Monkeys,
We love you!

Despite Rainbow Monkeys mostly being intended for feminine young girls, they are known to attract wider audiences. Numbuh 4 despises Rainbow Monkeys and thinks they're stupid, while Numbuh 3 is one of the biggest Rainbow Monkey fans, owning countless related items. Numbuh 86 may be an even bigger fan, apparently owning even more Rainbow Monkey memorabilia than Numbuh 3. Numbuh 1 secretly enjoys Rainbow Monkeys, owning a doll, and even Rainbow Monkey briefs. Even Numbuh 362 owns a pair of Rainbow Monkey slippers. In addition, many adults, even the villains, own Rainbow Monkey-related items.

Gallagher Elementary School is an elementary school attended by Sector V, Numbuh 86, Lizzie, the Class Presidents, and other local children. It features several unusual locations: the Fountain of Youth(hidden beneath the girls’ bathroom, this ancient underground spring keeps "Leaky" Leona young, though its effects must be regularly renewed); the Jungle Gym(contains a literal jungle with a chocolate volcano); the Auditorium(hosts assemblies, concerts, and election speeches for class presidents like Jimmy McGarfield); the Permanent Detention Area(a high-security prison-like area for rule-breaking students); the Gymnasium(a desert-like terrain controlled by kindergartners); the cafeteria(operated by Grandma Stuffum, who frequently battles the KND during lunch); and the Playground(beneath the basketball court lies a hidden deposit of salad oil, similar to petroleum reserves).

"2x4 Technology" refers to the improvised technology used by the Kids Next Door, built from household objects and rudimentary materials like wood and duct tape. Named after the common dimensions of a lumber piece, it serves as the foundation for all KND gadgets. Most devices are given acronymic names.

The Teens Next Door (TND) is a secret faction of elite former operatives who are allowed to remain with the KND with their memories intact after turning 13. To maintain cover, they pose as decommissioned or defected agents, often infiltrating the Teen Ninjas as spies. Only Global Command and a select few operatives know of their existence.

The Soopreme Leaduh is the highest-ranking officer of the Kids Next Door and the head of Global Command, overseeing all KND operations from the Moonbase. Unlike standard operatives, they rarely engage in field missions, instead managing intelligence, adult surveillance, cadet graduations, and diplomatic talks with teens. Granted unrestricted access to classified KND data, they alone may authorize non-conventional decommissionings. Despite perks like unlimited ice cream, a private office, and mandatory respect from all operatives, it comes with an immense workload—primarily paperwork, endless complaints and demands, and the burden of leading a organization of children with short attention spans. Practically nobody wants the job because of this, so succession is determined through a chaotic, organization-wide game of tag—whoever remains "it" by noon becomes the next Soopreme Leaduh. Like all operatives, they face decommissioning at thirteen unless deemed worthy of joining the Teens Next Door.

The Super Big Computermabob is the Kids Next Door’s central computer system, responsible for assigning operatives their Numbuhs and sectors. It also stores the genetic data of every recruit, uploaded via the C.O.D.E.-M.O.D.U.L.E., ensuring secure identification within the organization.

entries.content: The Kids Next Door Seriously Cool Museum of Artifacts and Stuff is a dedicated repository of KND history, housing artifacts, legendary 2x4 technology, and earwax statues of infamous villains. Curated by Numbuh 101, the museum features notable exhibits such as a diorama of the missing Sector Z, the Recommissioning Module, the KNDNA Tracker, and various legendary KND ships and weapons. A gift shop and snack bar cater to visitors, while a hidden emergency switch summons Sector V in the event of an attack.

entries.content: Yipper: Dobermans of the Sky(or Yipper for short) is a popular multimedia franchise centered around Yipper, a yellow dog with a red nose who pilots a red plane. The franchise follows his aerial battles against enemy dogs, including his rival, Hindenburg Hound. Primarily appealing to young boys—including male KND operatives—it spans trading cards, action figures, video games, comic books, a TV cartoon, and even a chain of themed pizza restaurants.

The Cadets Next Door serves as the KND's training academy, preparing recruits for operative status. Overseen by Numbuh 60 at the Arctic Base, cadets endure six weeks of rigorous training—including combat drills against progressively tougher robots. Entry requires passing a written exam, with applicants excelling in skills like running, hiding, or problem-solving having higher chances of acceptance. Each year, graduates attend a Moonbase ceremony, where they insert their booger into the C.O.D.E.-M.O.D.U.L.E., choose a Numbuh, and receive their sector assignment—officially joining the KND. The event concludes with an afterparty where new operatives celebrate alongside their older comrades.
